chatops.help:
IsItDown commands

/status — every provider, worst first
/status <provider> — one provider
/history <provider> [7|30|90] — uptime over a window
/mute <provider> <30m|2h|1d> — stop alerts for a while
/unmute <provider> — start them again
/help — this message
chatops.status.heading: {count} of {total} provider(s) are not operational.
chatops.status.empty: No providers are being watched yet.
chatops.history.heading: {provider} — last {days} day(s)
chatops.history.unmeasured: Nothing has been measured for {provider} in the last {days} day(s).
chatops.mute.done: {provider} is muted until {until}. Alerts resume by themselves after that.
chatops.error.bad-duration: {duration} is not a duration I understand. Try 30m, 2h or 1d, up to 30d.
chatops.error.bad-window: {window} is not a window I keep. Ask for 7, 30 or 90 days.
chatops.error.unknown-provider: I am not watching anything called {provider}.
chatops.error.unknown-command: /{command} is not a command. Send /help for the list.
